Hi, this is Julie from the Albertson Conference Center
returning your call about reserving space for a directors
meeting. You wanted to reserve our Forest Room on June
fifteenth for the meeting. Unfortunately, that conference room
is already reserved on that date. However, the Lake Room
is available, and it has a great view of the lake on our
property—which makes it popular for corporate clients. Let
me know if that works for you. And ® did you want to have
your directors meeting catered? My colleague, ° Joe Morton,
can help with that. Please call him at 555-0128. Thanks.
